content: Uca ixarreṣ AREBBI di Nuḥ u di marra řmař n řexřa d marra řebhayem i tuɣa akides deg uɣarrabu. Igga AREBBI ad yekk ijj n usemmiḍ x temmurt ařami arsan waman.
Bellɛent řɛunṣarat n waman ihewřen d tburjatin n ujenna uca ibedd wenẓar zeg ujenna.
Uca, am dd-ttasen ttraḥen, dewřen-dd waman zi temmurt. Awarni mya u-xemsin n wussan neqṣen waman.
Deg uyur wiss sebɛa, deg wass wiss sbeɛṭac n uyur nni, yarsa uɣarrabu x idurar n Ararat.
Qqimen waman neqqṣen ař ayur wiss ɛecra. Deg uyur wiss ɛecra, deg wass amezwaru n uyur, ḍharent-i-dd tqiccatin n idurar.
Awarni řami ɛdun arebɛin n wussan, yarzem Nuḥ taburjet n uɣarrabu nni dayes tuɣa igga,
uca issekk abaɣeř. Wanita iffeɣ, iqqim ittraḥ ittas-dd ařami bdan waman ttaẓɣen x temmurt.
Xenni issekk ssenni tadbirt, ḥima ad iẓar, ma aman neqṣen x wudem n temmurt.

Maca war tufi tedbirt mani ɣa tessars tařeqqa n uḍar nnes uca teɛqeb-dd ɣares ɣar uɣarrabu, minzi aman tuɣa aten ɛad x wudem n marra tammurt. Isswiẓẓeḍ afus nnes, iṭṭef i-tt uca issidef i-tt-i-dd ɣares deg uɣarrabu.
Iraja ɛad sebɛa n wussan nneɣni, xenni issekk tadbirt ɛawed zeg uɣarrabu.
Uca tadbirt teɛqeb-dd ɣares ɣar tmeddit, u xzar, aqa afar n zzitun deg uqemmum nnes. Xenni ifhem Nuḥ belli aman neqṣen zi temmurt.
Iraja ɛad sebɛa n wussan, xenni issekk tadbirt ɛawed uca nettat war ɣares dd-teɛqib ɛad.

Deg useggʷas wiss setta-mya u-waḥit n Nuḥ, deg uyur amezwaru, deg wass amezwaru n uyur nni, uẓɣen waman x temmurt. Iksi Nuḥ tawwart n useqqaf n uɣarrabu, ixzar ɣar barra, uca xzar, udem n temmurt aqa yuẓeɣ.
Deg uyur wiss tnayen, deg wass wiss sebɛa u-ɛicrin n uyur nni, tuẓeɣ temmurt.
Xenni issiweř AREBBI ak-d Nuḥ, inna:
“Ffeɣ zeg uɣarrabu, cek d temɣart nnec d iḥenjiren nnec d temɣarin n iḥenjiren nnec akidek.

Marra min iddaren i iǧan akidek, zi marra min ɣarsen arrimet n weysum, zeg ijḍaḍ, zi řmař u zi marra imuddaren nni ittbuɛen x temmurt, ejj i-ten ad ffɣen akidek, ejj i-ten ad mṭarracen x temmurt, ad arren řɣiǧet uca ad mmarenyen x temmurt.”
Iffeɣ Nuḥ d iḥenjiren nnes d temɣart nnes d temɣarin n iḥenjiren nnes akides.
Marra řmař n řexřa, marra min ittbuɛen, d marra ijḍaḍ, d marra min ittenhezzan x temmurt ffɣen zeg uɣarrabu ɛlaḥṣab řaǧat nsen.
Ibna Nuḥ ijj n uɛalṭar i SIDI uca iksi zi marra řmař n řeḥřař u zi marra ijḍaḍ n řeḥřař uca iqeddem tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ x uɛalṭar.

Uca icemm SIDI řefwaḥet ittfuḥen uca inna SIDI deg wuř nnes: “War ttɛiqqibeɣ ɛad ad neɛřeɣ tammurt x ssibbet n bnadem, minzi min dd-itteffɣen zeg wuř n bnadem d aɛeffan waha zi temẓi nnes. War ttɛiqqibeɣ ɛad ad wteɣ marra min iddaren am mammec ggiɣ.
Marra ussan i ɣa teqqim temmurt teǧa, ad tiři tyarza d tmeyra, teṣmeḍ d řeḥmu, anebdu d řmecta uca ass d ǧiřet war ttbeddin ɛemmarṣ.”
